title: Source Family Canonicalization and Dedup
problem: CT/ct appeared as separate contradictory outcomes in live canonical reports, breaking delta memory, research quality, CT loss stage, terminality, validator, and triage

helpers_added: normalize_source_family_name(value: str) -> str — maps mixed-case to canonical lowercase (ct, public, feed, wayback, passive_dns, academic, ipfs, pivot)
canonicalize_source_family_outcomes(outcomes: list[dict]) -> list[dict] — dedup + merge same-family entries

merge_rules.error: first real provider error over synthetic (http_502 > no_candidates)
merge_rules.terminal_state: highest-priority (ATTEMPTED_ACCEPTED > ATTEMPTED_TIMEOUT > ATTEMPTED_ERROR > ATTEMPTED_NO_RESULTS > SKIPPED > NEVER_SCHEDULED)

files_modified: core/__main__.py — canonicalize_source_family_outcomes import + call after _sfo_list assembly
runtime/sprint_scheduler.py — canonicalize_source_family_outcomes import + call at terminality SSOT return
tools/live_artifact_triage.py — _has_ct AND _has_feed use family key + lowercase compare

assertions.canonicalize_removes_duplicates: canonicalize removes duplicate normalized family names
assertions.ct_ct_duplicate_merges: CT/ct duplicate merges to one ct outcome
assertions.error_priority: provider error http_502 wins over synthetic no_candidates
assertions.live_report_single_ct: Live report with CT+ct normalizes to exactly one ct
assertions.delta_memory_ct_attempted: evidence_delta_memory sees ct attempted=True via lowercase check
assertions.triage_case_insensitive: live_artifact_triage reads canonical family field case-insensitively
